| description = 

These pirates wander various regions of [[Firiona Vie]].  They tend to avoid areas which are also populated by Drachnids.  Nearly all of these pirates carry a Fine Steel Rapier which is Lore and No-Drop.  If you wish to hunt them for their fine steel weapons, look for pirates dual-wielding or carrying any weapon other than a single rapier.  They tend to be Iksar, Humans, Half-Elves, Barbarians, or Dwarves. Unlike [[a pirate cartographer]], they are always male.

All Firiona Vie pirates con blue to a level 35 player. Most are either blue or white at 30. The first green cons appear at level 36. (Guards and npcs in town would not assist a woodelf ranger being attacked by pirate, all npcs conned Kindly to me)

<ul>
  <li>''Note: Pirates are Rogues and will backstab if their target's back is turned to them.''
</ul>
